    @pytest.mark.priority(8)
    @allure.title("AC7: Validate Community Interaction After Deleting Emoji Reaction")
    @allure.description("Delete an emoji reaction via API and verify Group Interaction table is updated accordingly")
    def test_08_validate_delete_emoji_reaction(self):
        """Test that deleting an emoji reaction is reflected in Community Interaction"""
    
        assert self.message_id is not None and self.user_id is not None
        assert self.current_emoji_type is not None, "❌ Current emoji type required. Run test_07 first."
    
        # Step 1: Get initial Today's count
        self.coach_page.reload()
        self.coach_page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        initial_today_count = self.group_interaction_page.get_today_interaction_count()
        self.group_interaction_page.delete_emoji_reaction(
            auth_token=self.user_auth_token,
            message_id=self.message_id,
            user_id=self.user_id,
            emoji_type=self.current_emoji_type,
            cohort_name=self.api_cohort_name
        )
    
        # Step 3: Refresh the page
        self.coach_page.reload()
        self.coach_page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        updated_today_count = self.group_interaction_page.get_today_interaction_count()
